scope_note: Machine-checkable manifest for the claim-vs-enforcement audit. It classifies the enforcement-flavoured claims (claims that assert the code enforces / gates / blocks / refuses / requires / verifies / signs something) on the buyer- and reviewer-facing surfaces named by #395: README.md, docs/AS-BUILT.md, docs/POSTURE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/SUPPLY-CHAIN.md, the in-app Manual (packages/vigil-ui/manual.js), the served remediation ladder (console/api.py::_REMEDIATION_LADDER, rendered by the Fixes screen), and the in-app authorization/legal text (there is NO dedicated in-app Legal PAGE; the legal/authorization text is the New-Assessment authorization gate + Charter screen in packages/vigil-ui/app.js and the README license section). Each entry carries a verdict (TRUE/SCOPED/FALSE/UNVERIFIABLE) and the deciding code_ref. Every FALSE or SCOPED verdict names a claims-registry entry that pins it. Honest bound: this is the enforcement-flavoured claim set, not a verbatim classification of every sentence in the 100 KB README; the load-bearing FALSE families from the interim audit are recorded in docs/claims/CLAIM-VS-ENFORCEMENT-AUDIT.md.

found_false_and_fixed.old_text: that registry is not yet built in this tree
found_false_and_fixed.fix: The claims registry (docs/claims/registry.json, W0-3 #398) exists in this tree with 57 entries and the guard docs/tests/test_claims_registry.py; the README stated it was not yet built. Corrected in this PR.

The bwrap sandbox uses --unshare-all (integration/vigil_integration/live/sandbox_exec.py::_BWRAP_BASE_FLAGS); AS-BUILT sec.8 said --unshare-net, contradicting the code AND the same doc's sec.2.2 row (line 124) and README line 525. Corrected in this PR.

claims.claim: Only a deterministic oracle mints a signed FACT
claims.rationale: The oracle bridge turns a proposal into a signed FACT only when the class is oracle-mapped AND the deterministic oracle fires; else a labelled lead.

claims.claim: It can only ever demote, never promote.
claims.rationale: The veracity firewall re-executes a cited proof and can only demote a claim, never promote one.

claims.claim: anything unknown falls to the strictest tier (A3)
claims.rationale: The Rust WARDEN classifier is danger-first and by whole words; an unknown action classifies to the strictest tier.

claims.claim: First failure wins; any error at all = deny.
claims.rationale: The conjunctive gate evaluates authority AND tier AND (destructive) threshold; first failure wins and any exception is a DENY.

claims.claim: it refuses an owner key at construction
claims.rationale: The offense-side worker is keyless by construction, so it can never mint a trusted record.

claims.claim: A class outside that map gets no challenge, so it
claims.rationale: Fresh per-run challenges are scoped to BUG_CLASS_CHALLENGE; oracle_for returns None for any other class. The claim states this condition inline, so it is TRUE as written.

claims.claim: Deny-by-default network egress
claims.rationale: The egress gate is a deny-by-default nftables firewall + scope proxy; the sandbox's only route out is the charter-scoped proxy.

claims.claim: are simply absent, and therefore denied.
claims.rationale: The governed terminal admits only local read/inspect binaries; network/interpreter/writer binaries are absent from the allowlist and therefore denied. The generated README allowlist block equals _TERMINAL_ALLOWLIST exactly (verified).

claims.claim: it can *never* auto-run
claims.rationale: terminal.run classifies A2 under the A1 offense ceiling so the conjunctive gate always QUEUES; the operator Run click is the approval.

claims.claim: unless **all seven** of these production preconditions hold
claims.rationale: The production refuse-to-start gate is OPT-IN (inert unless VIGIL_POSTURE=production). Registry W9-4 pins it default=off.

claims.claim: off-by-default and opt-in outside production
claims.rationale: The seccomp egress supervisor is off-by-default/opt-in; FORCED ON only under the production posture. Registry W10-8 pins it default=off.

claims.claim: public/`0.0.0.0` bind is refused
claims.rationale: The stdlib reverse proxy binds loopback or a private/tunnel address only; bind_ok refuses 0.0.0.0/unspecified/globally-routable.

claims.claim: re-verified OFFLINE 2/2
claims.rationale: A claim about a past external live-fire run against testasp.vulnweb.com; the offline re-verify of THOSE bytes needs the evidence store / a run and cannot be re-derived from the repo source alone.

claims.claim: Use VIGIL only against systems you own or are explicitly authorized
claims.rationale: Authorization-only posture is code-enforced: require_in_scope applies the categorical protected-domain floor then host_matches_scope; an out-of-scope host is denied.

claims.claim: Rejects non-canonical (y≥p) and low-order Ed25519 public keys
claims.rationale: load_public_key rejects non-canonical (y>=p) and low-order Ed25519 public keys, closing a keyless forgery against every threshold check.

claims.claim: the offense worker holds **no owner key**
claims.rationale: Inert seam: findings cross as validated signature-checked inert data; the offense worker holds no owner key.

claims.claim: First failure wins; any error is a DENY.
claims.rationale: Every target-touching action passes CRUCIBLE-authority AND WARDEN (+ destructive threshold); first failure wins; any error is a DENY.

claims.claim: An LLM-proposed finding becomes a signed FACT only if
claims.rationale: P9 oracle confirmation: a proposal becomes a signed FACT only if the deterministic oracle fires over the retained context and the class is oracle-mapped, else a labelled lead.

claims.claim: #296 made it FAIL-CLOSED
claims.rationale: The Strix shell gate is ON BY DEFAULT and fail-closed: attach_from_env raises WardenGateUnavailable on any wiring failure and stops the run.

claims.claim: with `--unshare-all`
claims.rationale: The sandbox.exec runner runs inside bwrap with --unshare-all (net/pid/ipc/uts/cgroup/user); the network unshare is the load-bearing egress floor.

claims.claim: `--unshare-all` + minimal RO allowlist
claims.rationale: Corrected in W15-3 (#395) from a stale --unshare-net. _BWRAP_BASE_FLAGS uses --unshare-all; pinned by test_sandbox_exec.py::test_argv_shape_enforces_the_floors.

claims.claim: burns the nonce atomically
claims.rationale: The per-action approval token is single-use, action-bound, owner-signed; the gate burns the nonce atomically (O_EXCL ledger). A replayed/rebound/expired token is refused.

claims.claim: The default tier is still `PERMISSIVE`
claims.rationale: Every model-egress site routes through kernel.sovereignty (fail-closed); the doc honestly states the DEFAULT tier is still PERMISSIVE, so the claim is TRUE as written.

claims.claim: VIGIL never executes the escalation
claims.rationale: E2 proves the grant path exists via a differential of BFS closures and does not use it; a design commitment, not a missing feature.

claims.claim: REQUIRES a genuine multi-signer quorum
claims.rationale: The multi-signer destruction quorum is REQUIRED only under VIGIL_POSTURE=production; outside production a 1-of-1 is permitted. Registry W9-5 pins the production-only condition.

claims.claim: No live cloud FACT has been claimed and none exists in the evidence store.
claims.rationale: The E-series oracles exist and are fixture-proven offline; the doc honestly discloses no live cloud FACT is claimed, so the disclosure is TRUE as written.

claims.claim: had a **live channel** to the real target and did
claims.rationale: A CLOSED posture status requires an applicable oracle with a live channel that did NOT fire (coverage verdict clean, non-empty oracle_kinds_run).

claims.claim: a CLOSED with no conclusive oracle is refused
claims.rationale: The offline binding-tier verifier re-checks the coverage-projection binding; a CLOSED with no conclusive oracle is refused, offline with no VIGIL installed.

claims.claim: It does **not** re-fire the oracle
claims.rationale: Honest bound stated in the signed bytes: the offline verifier does not re-fire the oracle; re-firing needs a VIGIL coverage re-run.

claims.claim: non-exploitability by the oracle family, over the reached surface
claims.rationale: CLOSED carries its coverage denominator and residual verbatim in the signed bytes; it never means secure-against-everything.

claims.claim: an executed action that left the envelope, is refused
claims.rationale: The Authority-Envelope conformance proof re-derives offline; a forged conformant verdict or an executed action outside the envelope is refused.

claims.claim: all **14 required status checks are green**
claims.rationale: The canonical file lists exactly 14 checks (verified); test_required_checks_canonical.py asserts every doc count/list agrees with it.

claims.claim: `main` cannot be force-pushed over or deleted
claims.rationale: Whether the LIVE branch blocks force-push/deletion is a GitHub setting, not code; offline it is asserted by branch-protection-verify.yml against the API, not re-derivable from repo source.

claims.claim: a scheduled protection handoff, not a shipped guarantee
claims.rationale: The doc explicitly states required reviews and required signed commits are NOT enforced; the canonical file's header says the same and lists no such control. An honest negative claim.

claims.claim: re-runs the identical hooks on your pull
claims.rationale: The advisory pre-commit workflow re-runs the identical hooks on the PR, so a --no-verify local skip does not bypass the check.

claims.claim: `make gate` stays byte-identical
claims.rationale: The pinned benchmark gate must still pass unchanged; make gate is a byte-identical regression spine.

claims.claim: The job exits non-zero and the pull request cannot merge.
claims.rationale: CRITICAL findings block; trivy exits non-zero. Asserted statically by test_supply_chain.py in required jobs.

claims.claim: Raised from advisory to blocking in W3-9
claims.rationale: HIGH now blocks (raised in W3-9 once the vendored HIGH backlog cleared); the gate-severity tests pin HIGH,CRITICAL.

claims.claim: **Every action in every workflow**
claims.rationale: Every uses: in every workflow is a 40-hex SHA; the drift test fails on any tag/branch ref, with a negative control.

claims.claim: base-image drift (a Docker Hub tag that has moved) BLOCKS
claims.rationale: Resolvable (Docker Hub) drift blocks; an UNKNOWN registry blocks only under --fail-on-unknown, and a documented rolling-base allowlist is advisory. Registry W3-8 pins the carve-out.

claims.claim: MEDIUM-and-below vulnerability findings are advisory.
claims.rationale: A deliberate, disclosed trade: MEDIUM and below are surfaced not enforced; HIGH/CRITICAL block. TRUE as written.

claims.claim: `--require-hashes` is all-or-nothing
claims.rationale: pip rejects the whole file if one line lacks a hash; every runtime dep is installed under --require-hashes, asserted by test_supply_chain.py.

claims.claim: The PEP 517 build backends are hash-locked
claims.rationale: Build backends are hash-locked in build-backends.lock.txt; verify_native_locks.py checks offline that every direct native dep is pinned in its lock.

claims.claim: a queued action auto-rejects on a timer
claims.rationale: Nothing offensive fires on its own; a target-touching/destructive action queues and, on approval timeout, auto-rejects (fail-safe).

claims.claim: A finding is only marked CONFIRMED (a FACT) when a deterministic checker
claims.rationale: Only an oracle firing over data the real target produced makes a finding a FACT; the AI's opinion stays a LEAD.

claims.claim: It binds only to your machine or a private tunnel
claims.rationale: No part of VIGIL opens itself to the open internet; the proxy binds loopback/private only (bind_ok refuses a public bind).

claims.claim: never IP ranges (CIDR). Anything outside your scope is hard-denied, always.
claims.rationale: host_matches_scope supports literal / *.wildcard / IPv6-literal only; a CIDR entry is not a supported range, and a non-match returns False (deny). Verified.

claims.claim: single-use and expires in minutes
claims.rationale: Opening a PR is gated by an owner-inclusive m-of-n authorization that is single-use, action-bound, and time-boxed.

claims.claim: Everything fails open: if inspection ever errors, your traffic still flows.
claims.rationale: AEGIS Enforce blocks only PROVEN attacks and needs an entitlement; without it it downgrades to Observe, and inspection failure fails open so real traffic still flows. TRUE as written.

claims.claim: ONLY an oracle-confirmed FACT with signed evidence is eligible.
claims.rationale: The served ladder shows the tier the WARDEN gate really assigns for each stage; a LEAD can never trigger a code change. Registry REM-LADDER pins ladder<->gate agreement.

claims.claim: above the A1 offense auto-ceiling, so it QUEUES for
claims.rationale: The clone/edit/build stages are A2 (above the A1 offense auto-ceiling) so they QUEUE for owner approval; the served tier is the tier the gate really assigns. Registry REM-LADDER.

claims.claim: OFF by default and NEVER run from this console:
claims.rationale: open-pr is OFF by default, refused from the console, and needs --open-pr + a token + a separate owner-inclusive m-of-n authorization. Registry REM-LADDER.

claims.claim: I am authorized to test this target (I own it or have written permission).
claims.rationale: The in-app New-Assessment authorization gate carries an explicit authorization checkbox; the binding enforcement is the signed charter/scope (next row).

claims.claim: The binding authorization is the signed charter
claims.rationale: The UI text honestly says the checkbox is not the control; authorize_action enforces the signed charter scope (kill-switch, validity window, scope, destructive controls, budget).

claims.claim: Government & public-sector use is EXCLUDED from the free grant
claims.rationale: A licensing term (Government-Use Supplemental Term in LICENSE). Its enforcement is legal, not code; there is no code gate that keys on the licensee's sector.
